article.story: MONROE, La. -- — Max Alexander had 20 points in Houston Christian’s 84-58 win over Louisiana-Monroe on Tuesday night. Alexander added five assists for the Huskies (5-1). Chris Mubiru added 17 points and eight rebounds while shooting 6 for 9, including 4 for 6 from beyond the arc. Kris Keinys went 5 of 6 from the field to finish with 12 points. Dayjaun Anderson finished with 27 points, six rebounds and four assists for the Warhawks (2-7). Phillip Tillman added nine points, seven rebounds and five assists for UL Monroe. Jean Yvens Lafleur finished with six points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
